name: When should I consider making my bathroom accessible?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider making my bathroom accessible?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider making your bathroom accessible if you or a family member are experiencing mobility challenges, planning for future aging-in-place needs, or if you require specific accommodations due to an injury or disability. Proactive modifications can enhance safety, independence, and comfort in your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider modifications when experiencing mobility challenges, planning for aging-in-place, or due to injury or disability.
